name: rules-rtdb-r31-token-claims
description: RTDB rules production verdicts for corpus scenario "r31-token-claims" (rtdb#71). Captured by deploy-observe-restore (RTDB has no server-side rules test API). role and tenant gates read custom claims from auth.token, so the simulator must expose the claims a custom token carries with their types, and read an absent claim the way production does.
